description: List transactional email templates with subjects, delivery metrics, API slugs, and dashboard URLs. Each item also carries `emailPreset`, the per-email Style > Format (branded or minimal, null for a standalone raw HTML email), so a chrome drift check across templates does not need one get_transactional_email call each. `managedBy` is `code` for emails created by `send_email` with `trackAs`: their content is a snapshot of recent sends and they cannot be sent by `templateId`. Search by name, slug, or email title; filter active state; and sort by sends, opens, open rate, clicks, or CTR.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

includeMachineEngagement.description: Include bot, scanner, and privacy-proxy engagement in open and click metrics. Defaults to false.

labels.description: Filter by label names; matches any supplied name.

order.description: Sort order: asc or desc. Defaults to desc.

search.description: Case-insensitive search across template name, API slug, and linked email subject/title.

sort.description: Sort field: date, sends, opens, open-rate, clicks, or ctr. Defaults to date.

status.description: Template status: all, active, or disabled.

name: list_transactional_emails
